backend_basis: User-specified Python guard and existing sealed Python analysis workflow; task-local preference only.
claim_boundaries: No learning, grades, satisfaction or other-course generalisation claims
No component causal claims for router-selected strata
No calibrated or averaged Human-Judge outcome

export_contract.target: Thesis-ready figures; no claim of compliance with unverified current journal submission rules

figures.claim: Only the targeted Planning removal contrast meets the predeclared improvement interpretation; all effects and pointwise intervals remain visible.
evidence_chain: All eight paired mean differences with 95% family-cluster percentile bootstrap intervals
Five and three Holm families separately identified; exact adjusted values accompany the plot
figures.question: What do all eight predeclared paired comparisons establish?
figures.selection: All eight in registry order; no sorting by effect or p value.

figures.claim: All nine modes have high descriptive means and medians; these absolute values require the frozen Human-Judge bias qualification.
evidence_chain: Mean and median for each of nine modes; n=62 paired scenarios per mode
Descriptive display only; no inference from marginal ranking or overlapping markers
figures.question: What are the absolute Judge-rated primary outcome levels?

figures.claim: Criterion means have different applicable denominators; ERROR_HANDLING is entirely NA for C0.
evidence_chain: All eight primary dimensions by all nine modes
Every cell shows mean and applicable count; missing cells stay NA
figures.question: How do descriptive rubric profiles and applicability vary across modes?
figures.selection: All 72 criterion-mode cells; no significance annotations.

figures.claim: Availability, activation and successful content return differ across components and must remain distinct.
evidence_chain: a: RAG activation decomposed into SUPPORTED, LIMITED_EVIDENCE and NO_RESULT
b: Memory activation decomposed into AVAILABLE and NO_MATCH
c: Planner activation decomposed into USED and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
figures.question: How often did component availability yield activation and substantive output?
figures.selection: All nine modes in each comparable panel; count scale shared; activation totals do not include inactive conditions.

qa_contract.fallback: If PyMuPDF absent, validate final Matplotlib-rendered text and stroke geometry with the same collision geometry core, plus complete raster visual inspection; do not call it a PDF geometry audit.
qa_contract.pdf_collision_tool: Run provided tool; record any dependency blocker without claiming a pass. Offline authorization prohibits installing packages from a network.
qa_contract.reproducibility: Rebuild figures in memory from hash-bound aggregate data, fixed layout/font/SVG hashsalt and deterministic metadata.

statistical_contract.unit: 62 paired scenarios; one scenario per family

writing_axes.argument: The full system did not establish a reliable improvement over Evidence; only the predeclared Planning removal comparison supported a higher Judge-rated primary outcome under the frozen analysis.
